narr: Strong upper level and surface areas of low pressure moved NE into the Midwest, while a cold front along with a secondary weak low, formed and moved through the area. Gradient wind gusts, along with enhanced wind gusts associated with severe thunderstorms and a strong low level jet, resulted in widespread tree damage.
ev: A small unnamed stream flooded, with water covering the roadway, on Calvin Hall Rd at Elven Dr. The road was impassable. Time estimated.
Rum Creek and surrounding tributaries flooded and affected two homes on Country Club Dr. Both homes were flooded by 2 to 4 feet of water.
Man O War Dr in Indian Land was flooded and impassable. Time estimated.
